signature: NTSTATUS WINAPI BCryptGenRandom(BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE hAlgorithm, PUCHAR pbBuffer, ULONG cbBuffer, ULONG dwFlags)
empirical_windows_behavior: When hAlgorithm == NULL, BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG (0x00000002) must be set or STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE (0xc0000008) is returned.
When hAlgorithm != NULL and BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG is set, returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER (0xc000000d).
macos_backend_strategy: Use Apple CommonCrypto CCRandomGenerateBytes and Security.framework SecRandomCopyBytes on __APPLE__.
